prompt: List every file in this directory, hidden ones included, in long form
hint: -l is the long listing, -a stops hiding dotfiles.

prompt: Find every .log file under the current directory
hint: -name matches the basename and needs the glob quoted.

prompt: Find files under . modified in the last 2 days
hint: -mtime -2 means 'less than 2 days old'.

prompt: Copy the directory src to dest, contents and all
hint: -r recurses into the directory.

prompt: Rename the file old to new
hint: mv both moves and renames.

prompt: Delete the directory build and everything in it
hint: -r recurses, -f suppresses prompts. No undo.

prompt: Create the nested directory a/b/c in one command
hint: -p creates missing parents instead of erroring.

prompt: Create a symlink named link pointing at target
hint: Target comes first, then the name of the link.

prompt: Show the total size of the dir directory in human units
hint: -s summarises instead of listing every file, -h is human-readable.

prompt: Show free disk space on all mounts in human units
hint: -h turns blocks into K/M/G.

prompt: Count the lines in file.txt
hint: -l counts lines, -w words, -c bytes.

prompt: Show what kind of file data.bin is
hint: file inspects content, not the extension.

prompt: Search every file under . for the text TODO
hint: -r walks the directory tree.

prompt: Search file.txt for error, ignoring case
hint: -i makes the match case-insensitive.

prompt: Search file.txt for error and show line numbers
hint: -n prefixes each hit with its line number.

prompt: Show every line of file.txt that does NOT contain debug
hint: -v inverts the match.

prompt: Replace every occurrence of old with new inside file.txt, in place
hint: -i edits the file itself; /g catches every hit on a line.

prompt: Show the first 20 lines of file.txt
hint: -n sets the count.

prompt: Show the last 20 lines of file.txt
hint: -n sets the count.

prompt: Watch app.log as new lines are written to it
hint: -f follows the file as it grows.

prompt: Sort file.txt and remove duplicate lines
hint: uniq only collapses adjacent duplicates, so sort first.

prompt: Count how often each line appears in file.txt, most frequent first
hint: -c counts, then -rn sorts numerically in reverse.

prompt: Print the second whitespace-separated column of file.txt
hint: awk splits on whitespace by default.

prompt: Print the first colon-separated field of /etc/passwd
hint: -d sets the delimiter, -f picks the field.

prompt: List every running process on the system
hint: aux is the classic BSD-style everything listing.

prompt: Politely terminate the process with PID 1234
hint: Plain kill sends SIGTERM, which lets the process clean up.

prompt: Force-kill PID 1234 immediately
hint: -9 is SIGKILL; it cannot be caught or cleaned up after.

prompt: Kill every process named firefox
hint: pkill matches by name instead of PID.

prompt: Find the PID of every process named nginx
hint: pgrep is pkill's read-only twin.

prompt: Run longtask in the background
hint: A trailing & detaches it from your prompt.

prompt: List the background jobs of this shell
hint: Jobs are per-shell, unlike ps.

prompt: Run longtask so it survives the terminal closing
hint: nohup detaches it from the terminal's hangup signal.

prompt: Make script.sh executable
hint: +x adds the execute bit for everyone.

prompt: Set script.sh to rwxr-xr-x using octal
hint: 7=rwx owner, 5=r-x group, 5=r-x other.

prompt: Change the owner of file.txt to user shaun and group users
hint: owner:group, colon separated.

prompt: Recursively give shaun ownership of the dir directory
hint: -R walks the whole tree.

prompt: Run pacman -Syu as root
hint: sudo elevates a single command.

prompt: Print the username you are currently acting as
hint: Useful for checking whether sudo actually took.

prompt: List the groups your user belongs to
hint: Group membership is what gates most device access.

prompt: Download https://x.dev/f.tar.gz keeping its remote filename
hint: -O (capital) keeps the remote name; -o renames.

prompt: Fetch https://x.dev/api quietly, printing only the body
hint: -s silences the progress meter.

prompt: Send exactly 4 pings to example.com
hint: -c bounds the count so it stops on its own.

prompt: List listening TCP sockets with the owning process
hint: l=listening t=tcp n=numeric p=process. ss replaced netstat.

prompt: Open a shell on host.dev as user shaun
hint: user@host, same shape as scp.

prompt: Copy local file.txt to /srv on host.dev as shaun
hint: Remote side is host:path.

prompt: Mirror the contents of src/ into dest/ preserving attributes
hint: The trailing slash on src means 'contents of', not 'the directory'.

prompt: Show all network interfaces and their addresses
hint: ip replaced ifconfig.

prompt: Create out.tar.gz containing the dir directory
hint: c=create z=gzip f=filename.

prompt: Extract out.tar.gz into the current directory
hint: x=extract. Modern tar detects the compression itself.

prompt: List what is inside out.tar.gz without extracting
hint: t=list. Always worth doing before extracting.

prompt: Zip the dir directory into out.zip
hint: -r is required for directories.

prompt: Extract out.zip here
hint: Add -d to choose a destination.

prompt: Compress file.txt in place with gzip
hint: Replaces the file with file.txt.gz.

prompt: Show the working tree status
hint: Your most-typed git command.

prompt: Stage every change in the working tree
hint: . stages from here down, -A stages the whole repo.

prompt: Commit staged changes with the message fix bug
hint: -m avoids opening the editor.

prompt: Push the current branch to its remote
hint: Add -u origin branch the first time.

prompt: Fetch and merge the remote's changes
hint: Equivalent to git fetch then git merge.

prompt: Create a branch called feature and switch to it
hint: switch is the modern verb; checkout -b still works.

prompt: Show the history one commit per line
hint: Add --graph to see the branch shape.

prompt: Show the diff of what is staged but not committed
hint: Plain git diff shows unstaged changes instead.

prompt: Throw away uncommitted changes to file.txt
hint: restore is the modern verb. This is destructive.

prompt: List the remotes with their URLs
hint: -v shows fetch and push URLs.

prompt: Show the status of the nginx service
hint: Includes the last few log lines.

prompt: Restart the nginx service
hint: Use reload instead if the unit supports it.

prompt: Make nginx start at boot
hint: enable is boot-time; start is now. --now does both.

prompt: Restart the user-level waybar service
hint: --user targets your session's units, not the system's.

prompt: Show the logs for the nginx unit
hint: -u filters to one unit.

prompt: Follow the system journal live
hint: -f behaves like tail -f.

prompt: Install the ripgrep package
hint: -S syncs from the repos.

prompt: Search the installed packages for ones matching python
hint: -Q queries local packages; -Ss searches the repos instead.
